checks: Creation generates immutable identity, initial history, and seven-day follow-up
Case-insensitive active duplicates return 409 and concurrent duplicate insertions stay unique
Company counters increase, stay separate, and avoid shared-prefix collisions
Future and impossible dates, negative salary, invalid job types, and client-generated fields are rejected
Company search and status filters combine, include literal regex text, and return counts for zero statuses
Overdue is calculated from dates and calendar arithmetic crosses month and leap-day boundaries
Every permitted workflow branch appends timestamped history; all final stages remain locked
Skipped, reverse, repeated, and client-forged status changes are rejected without changing history
Deletion is forbidden in Interview/Offer and allowed in Applied and every final stage
Editing changes permitted values but cannot alter applied date, issued ID, status, or history
Active duplicate edits fail; finalizing a record permits a fresh application with a higher sequence
Past applications lose overdue status after leaving Applied; follow-up day itself is not overdue
Concurrent status changes preserve a valid timeline without lost or duplicate events
Missing IDs, malformed JSON, and exhausted company numbers use consistent error envelopes
